tasks.title: Initialize React + Vite project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
tasks.description: Set up the foundational project with Vite, React 18, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. PWA configuration happens in Task 10.
tasks.details:
1. Initialize project with Vite React-TS template
2. Install and configure Tailwind CSS with darkMode: 'class'
3. Configure TypeScript strict mode and path aliases
4. Set up ESLint + Prettier
5. Create folder structure and clean up boilerplate
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: dev server starts, Tailwind dark theme renders, TypeScript compiles, build succeeds

subtasks.title: Initialize Vite project and install dependencies
subtasks.description: Run vite create with react-ts template. Install Tailwind CSS + PostCSS + Autoprefixer. Verify dev server starts.

subtasks.title: Configure Tailwind CSS with dark mode
subtasks.description: Configure tailwind.config.js (darkMode: 'class', content paths). Add Tailwind directives to index.css. Set global dark base styles. Delete App.css.

subtasks.title: Configure TypeScript strict mode and ESLint + Prettier
subtasks.description: Enable strict TS options. Add path aliases (@/*) in tsconfig + vite.config. Install and configure ESLint + Prettier.

subtasks.title: Create folder structure and clean up boilerplate
subtasks.description: Create src/{components, pages, hooks, services, types, utils, contexts, data}. Remove Vite template files. Create minimal App.tsx with dark theme.

tasks.title: Configure Supabase backend with database schema
tasks.description: Set up Supabase project, create database schema (routines, exercises, workout_logs), configure RLS and Storage bucket.
tasks.details:
1. Create Supabase project, install client, create .env.local and supabase.ts
2. Create tables with foreign keys, constraints, and indexes
3. Enable RLS: users can only access own data
4. Create Storage bucket 'exercise-media' (public read, auth upload, 10MB, JPG/GIF)
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: Client connects, tables exist, RLS blocks unauthorized access, Storage works

subtasks.title: Create Supabase project and initialize client
subtasks.description: Create project on supabase.com. Install client packages. Create .env.local and src/services/supabase.ts with createClient().

subtasks.title: Create database schema
subtasks.description: Create tables: routines, exercises (with muscle_group CHECK constraint using English values), workout_logs. Add performance indexes.

subtasks.title: Enable Row Level Security
subtasks.description: Enable RLS on all tables. Routines/workout_logs: auth.uid() = user_id. Exercises: via JOIN to routines.user_id.

subtasks.title: Configure Storage bucket
subtasks.description: Create 'exercise-media' bucket (public, 10MB, JPG/GIF). Policies: auth upload, public read, owner delete.

tasks.title: Implement authentication flow with Supabase Auth
tasks.description: Create login/signup with email auth, protected routes, session management, and sign-out.
tasks.details:
1. Install react-router-dom, configure public and protected routes
2. Create AuthContext with session state and onAuthStateChange
3. Create Auth.tsx with Supabase Auth UI (dark theme, email only)
4. Create ProtectedRoute and Header (with sign-out) components
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: Sign up/login works, protected routes redirect, logout clears session, refresh maintains auth

subtasks.title: Install react-router-dom and configure routes
subtasks.description: Define routes: /auth (public), /routines, /workout/:routineId, /routine/:routineId/edit (protected). Create placeholder pages.

subtasks.title: Create AuthContext with session management
subtasks.description: AuthContext with session/user/loading. Subscribe to onAuthStateChange. signOut function. useAuth hook. Wrap app with AuthProvider.

subtasks.title: Build Auth page with Supabase Auth UI
subtasks.description: Auth.tsx with Supabase Auth UI (dark theme, email only). Redirect to /routines if authenticated.

subtasks.title: Create ProtectedRoute and Header components
subtasks.description: ProtectedRoute: redirect to /auth if unauthenticated. Header: user email + sign-out button. Include Header in ProtectedRoute layout.

tasks.title: Create routine management interface (CRUD)
tasks.description: Build UI to create, view, edit, and delete routines with exercise lists and drag-and-drop reordering.
tasks.details:
1. Routines.tsx dashboard with grid layout and empty state
2. RoutineCard component (name, exercise count, Start/Edit/Delete)
3. Create routine modal (Headless UI + React Hook Form)
4. RoutineEditor with dnd-kit drag-and-drop for exercises
5. ExerciseForm and delete routine with confirmation
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: CRUD routines, add exercises, drag-and-drop persists, cascade delete

subtasks.title: Create Routines dashboard
subtasks.description: Fetch routines with exercise count, render in responsive grid. Empty state with CTA.

subtasks.title: Build RoutineCard component
subtasks.description: Card: routine name, exercise count, date. Buttons: Start Workout, Edit, Delete.

subtasks.title: Implement create routine modal
subtasks.description: Install @headlessui/react + react-hook-form. CreateRoutineModal with name input. createRoutine service function.

subtasks.title: Create RoutineEditor with drag-and-drop
subtasks.description: Install @dnd-kit. RoutineEditor page: sortable exercise list, persist sort_order. "Add Exercise" button.

subtasks.title: Build ExerciseForm and delete functionality
subtasks.description: ExerciseForm: name, muscle_group (English enum), machine_info, target_sets_reps. Create + edit mode. Delete routine with confirmation modal.

tasks.title: Implement swipe-based workout session interface
tasks.description: Mobile-first workout mode with Swiper for horizontal exercise navigation, weight/reps/comment inputs, save-on-slide-change.
tasks.details:
1. Install Swiper, create WorkoutSession.tsx with routineId param
2. Fetch exercises by sort_order, pre-fill from last workout_logs
3. Each slide: exercise info, media, weight/reps/comment inputs
4. Save-on-slide-change (INSERT new, UPDATE revisited via Map<exerciseId, logId>)
5. Progress indicator + "Complete Workout" button on last slide
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: Swipe navigates, pre-fill works, slide-change saves, complete flushes and navigates

subtasks.title: Set up WorkoutSession with Swiper
subtasks.description: Install Swiper. Create WorkoutSession.tsx with useParams. Basic layout with loading/error states.

subtasks.title: Fetch exercises and pre-fill from last workout
subtasks.description: Fetch exercises ordered by sort_order. For each, fetch last workout_log values. Promise.all for parallel fetch.

subtasks.title: Render exercise slides with inputs
subtasks.description: SwiperSlides: exercise info, media, numeric weight/reps inputs, comment textarea. Mobile-first with large touch targets.

subtasks.title: Implement save-on-slide-change
subtasks.description: onSlideChange: save previous slide. Track in Map<exerciseId, logId> (INSERT if new, UPDATE if revisited). Progress indicator.

subtasks.title: Add "Complete Workout" button
subtasks.description: Last slide: flush all pending saves, navigate to /routines with success message. Error handling with retry.

tasks.title: Build exercise media upload system
tasks.description: Upload JPG/GIF exercise media to Supabase Storage with preview, drag-and-drop, and delete.
tasks.details:
1. MediaUpload component: file input (JPG/GIF, max 10MB), validation, preview
2. Upload to Supabase Storage, update exercises.media_url
3. Drag-and-drop zone with react-dropzone
4. Delete media (Storage + DB) with confirmation
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: Upload works, preview displays, validation blocks invalid files, delete clears file and DB

subtasks.title: Create MediaUpload component with validation
subtasks.description: MediaUpload.tsx: accept JPG/GIF, validate size (10MB max), generate local preview.

subtasks.title: Implement upload to Supabase Storage
subtasks.description: Upload to exercise-media/{user_id}/{exercise_id}/{timestamp.ext}. Get public URL, update media_url. Progress + error handling.

subtasks.title: Build drag-and-drop UI with preview
subtasks.description: Install react-dropzone. Drag-and-drop zone, image preview, upload button, loading spinner, error display.

subtasks.title: Add delete media functionality
subtasks.description: Delete with confirmation. Remove from Storage + clear media_url in DB.

tasks.title: Enhance workout session with service layer, quick-adjust, and offline sync
tasks.description: Create saveWorkoutLog service, add +/- buttons for weight/reps, save animation, integrate offline utilities from Task 10.4.
tasks.details:
1. workoutLogService.ts with saveWorkoutLog() function
2. Quick-adjust buttons: +/- 2.5kg weight, +/- 1 rep
3. Input validation (weight >= 0, reps >= 1)
4. Framer Motion save animation
5. Offline routing: online -> Supabase, offline -> IndexedDB (Task 10.4)
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: saveWorkoutLog works, quick-adjust buttons work, validation, animation, offline sync

subtasks.title: Create saveWorkoutLog service
subtasks.description: workoutLogService.ts: saveWorkoutLog(userId, exerciseId, weight, reps, comment, date). Date as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Export WorkoutLog type.

subtasks.title: Add quick-adjust buttons and validation
subtasks.description: +/- 2.5kg around weight, +/- 1 around reps in WorkoutSession slides. Enforce min values. Large touch targets.

subtasks.title: Add save animation
subtasks.description: Install framer-motion. Small "Saved" checkmark indicator with AnimatePresence. Auto-hide 1.5s. Red error on failure.

subtasks.title: Integrate offline utilities
subtasks.description: Import from Task 10.4. Online -> saveWorkoutLog, offline -> saveWorkoutLogLocally. Sync on reconnect. "Saved" (green) vs "Queued" (yellow).
subtasks.note: Requires Task 10.4 (IndexedDB data layer) to be completed first.

tasks.title: Import initial workout data from PRD
tasks.description: Seed data with 4 routines (Brust & Bizeps, Beine & Schultern, Ruecken & Trizeps, Ganzkoerper) and import button.
tasks.details:
1. seedData.ts with typed interfaces and 4 routines (German names, English muscle_group enums)
2. importSeedData(): check existing, batch insert routines + exercises
3. ImportWorkoutsButton with progress modal, only shown if 0 routines
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: 4 routines created correctly, English muscle_group values, blocked if routines exist

subtasks.title: Create seed data structures
subtasks.description: seedData.ts: RoutineData/ExerciseData interfaces. WORKOUT_ROUTINES with 4 routines. muscle_group = English enum values. Names in German.

subtasks.title: Implement importSeedData function
subtasks.description: Check for existing routines. Batch insert routines, get IDs. Insert exercises with foreign keys. Rollback on failure.

subtasks.title: Create ImportWorkoutsButton
subtasks.description: Button with idle/importing/success/error states. Progress modal. Place in settings page. Only show if 0 routines.

tasks.title: Mobile-first responsive design with bottom navigation
tasks.description: Dark theme component styles, bottom navigation bar, mobile optimization, haptic feedback.
tasks.details:
1. Reusable dark-themed component styles (inputs, buttons, cards) with high contrast
2. Fixed bottom nav (Home, Routines, Profile) with safe-area insets
3. Primary actions in bottom third for thumb reach, responsive breakpoints
4. Haptic feedback via Vibration API
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: Consistent dark theme, readable text, tappable buttons, bottom nav, responsive, no horizontal scroll

subtasks.title: Apply global dark theme component styles
subtasks.description: Dark styles for inputs, buttons, cards, headers. Min 16px text. High contrast. Focus ring states.

subtasks.title: Build bottom navigation bar
subtasks.description: BottomNav.tsx: fixed bottom, safe-area insets. Home/Routines/Profile. Active state via useLocation(). In ProtectedRoute layout.

subtasks.title: Optimize for mobile and thumb reach
subtasks.description: Actions in bottom third. Responsive breakpoints (320px-768px+). Max-w-md on large screens. No horizontal scroll.

subtasks.title: Add haptic feedback
subtasks.description: haptics.ts: lightTap/mediumTap/heavyTap via Vibration API. Feature detection fallback. Graceful degradation.

tasks.title: Configure PWA offline functionality and deploy to Vercel
tasks.description: PWA service worker (Workbox), background sync for workout_logs, IndexedDB offline data layer (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH), deploy to Vercel.
tasks.details:
1. vite-plugin-pwa with injectManifest, PWA manifest
2. Custom service worker (src/sw.ts) with Workbox caching + background sync
3. IndexedDB data layer (src/utils/db.ts) -- central for all tasks
4. src/lib/offlineStorage.ts with sync functions
5. OfflineIndicator global component
6. Deploy to Vercel
tasks.testStrategy: Verify: PWA installs, offline works, background sync, Lighthouse > 90, no duplicate offline logic

subtasks.title: Configure vite-plugin-pwa
subtasks.description: Install vite-plugin-pwa + workbox. injectManifest strategy with src/sw.ts. PWA manifest, placeholder icons, theme-color meta.

subtasks.title: Create service worker with caching and background sync
subtasks.description: src/sw.ts: precacheAndRoute, NetworkFirst (API), StaleWhileRevalidate (media), CacheFirst (static). BackgroundSyncPlugin for workout_logs (24h retry).

subtasks.title: Build offline indicator
subtasks.description: OfflineIndicator.tsx + useOnlineStatus hook. Yellow offline banner, blue syncing, green success. Global in App.tsx.

subtasks.title: Set up IndexedDB data layer (CENTRAL)
subtasks.description: Install idb. src/utils/db.ts: WorkoutPlanDB stores + CRUD exports. src/lib/offlineStorage.ts: queueOfflineLog, syncOfflineLogs. Online/offline routing. Last-write-wins.
subtasks.note: This subtask is the dependency for Task 7.4 (offline integration).

subtasks.title: Deploy to Vercel
subtasks.description: Vercel CLI, vercel.json, env vars. Deploy. Test PWA install on iOS + Android. Verify HTTPS.
